thread:
Caroline: Quick sync — marketplace private-offer idea: offer an appliance trade-in credit for customers migrating reserved appliance capacity into a committed spend private offer. We need to align SKU mapping, partner discount stacking, SI onboarding credits, and joint announcement timing. @Mike @Raj any blockers? :thinking:
Mike: Love the idea. High level: propose commit ladder (6/12/24) + one-time trade-in credit that phases down over 12 months. Keeps ARR runway and rewards faster commit. Need to confirm marketplace price floors for appliance SKUs.
Raj: Marketplace ops note — on AWS/GCP private offers we must pass through a concrete unit price and cannot encode a separate "credit" outside the PO flow. We'll need a billing mapping: commit SKU + credit SKU that nets on invoice. Also check tax and resale rules for hardware partner credits.
Anne: From finance: two questions: 1) Are credits treated as deferred revenue reductions or rebates? 2) Do customers prepay or is this committed usage invoiced monthly? Depending on treatment we need updated recognition templates. Quick numbers help.
Jess: On the partner side: hardware partner wants co-funding for the trade-in credit and SI wants an onboarding rebate for first 3 months of usage. We should gate co-fund by minimum commit (e.g., $250k ARR) and require a joint playbook for installation + first call. Also ask partners for a short co-sell asset pack.
Caroline: Good flags. My answers: credits -> rebate applied against committed spend (documented on PO); we prefer prepaid commitments (customer pays/downpay) for easier recognition, but can support invoiced monthly as a fallback. Proposal: trade-in credit = 15% of first-year commit, SI onboarding rebate = flat $10k (one-off).
Emily: Legal: need language for "trade-in" proof and transfer of title for old appliances if partner demands. Also add clause about credit clawback if customer cancels within 90 days. I'll draft a clause and loop PMM for messaging.
Mike: Ops/implementation note: mapping snippet draft for marketplace team — can we do this?
```
SKU: redwood.commit.annual.1yr
UnitPrice: 9000000   # cents
CreditSKU: redwood.tradein.credit
CreditAmount: 1350000 # cents (15%)
```
Raj: That mapping should work technically but add a reconciliation row so reporting shows gross commit, credit, net ARR. Also verify partner invoicing flow if credit funded by partner (we'll need an intercompany PO).
Caroline: Timeline proposal: legal & finance review this week, partner sign-off next week, engineering/marketplace mapping by Friday for a soft-launch private offer in 3 weeks. Can everyone ack and drop any absolute blockers?
Jess: Ack, will confirm partner co-fund numbers by EOD tomorrow. Need marketing asset ETA (PMM). :white_check_mark:
Anne: Finance ack, will prepare recognition note and run impact with revenue ops.
Emily: Legal will ship draft clauses in 48h.
partners-bot: Calendar: created meeting 'trade-in commit offer sync' Thu 10am PT and invited Caroline, Mike, Raj, Anne, Jess, Emily.
